title: parley.send@1 (decision kind, floor decide, safety none): bound args
description: An agent's message to another agent (inventory P1, P2). One that leaves this machine is requested with reachesOut: safety send at confirm, and no 'always allow' (the owner, open question 5). The text is bound by ref. Preview rows, in order: From, To, Machine, Message. Options: approve 'Send' (decide; confirm when it reaches out), approveAllow 'Send and always allow' (local, only on this machine), sendBack needsText (decide), decline 'Discard' (narrow).
